# Tool & Configuration Reference

Generated directly from `omada_mcp.tools.TOOLS` (**135 total**: **55 read-only**, **80 opt-in write**).

- Required parameters are shown in **`bold`**; optional parameters carry `?`.
- Site-scoped tools accept optional `site?` (pinned when `OMADA_SITE_NAME`/`OMADA_SITE_ID` is set unless `OMADA_ALLOW_CROSS_SITE=true`).
- Write tools require `OMADA_READ_ONLY=false` and explicit `OMADA_WRITE_TOOLS` allowlisting. Preview with `dryRun=true`, then pass the single-use `confirmToken` as `confirm` with `dryRun=false` in the same server session.

## Environment Variables (`server.json`)

| Variable | Required | Secret | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `OMADA_BASE_URL` | yes | no | Omada controller web UI root URL (https://<host>:8043 or http://<host>:8088) |
| `OMADA_USERNAME` | yes | no | Dedicated local controller username (Viewer for read-only, Admin for opt-in writes) |
| `OMADA_PASSWORD` | yes | yes | Password for the local Omada controller account |
| `OMADA_SITE_NAME` | no | no | Optional default Omada site display name (pins site unless OMADA_ALLOW_CROSS_SITE=true) |
| `OMADA_SITE_ID` | no | no | Optional default Omada site hex ID (alternative to OMADA_SITE_NAME) |
| `OMADA_ALLOW_CROSS_SITE` | no | no | Allow per-call site overrides to target other visible sites when a default site is pinned (default false) |
| `OMADA_READ_ONLY` | no | no | Fail-closed read-only mode (default true; set false only with explicit OMADA_WRITE_TOOLS) |
| `OMADA_WRITE_TOOLS` | no | no | Comma-separated explicit allowlist of write tool names when OMADA_READ_ONLY=false |
| `OMADA_VERIFY_SSL` | no | no | Verify TLS certificate chain and hostname (default true) |
| `OMADA_CA_BUNDLE` | no | no | Optional path to a controller CA PEM bundle |
| `OMADA_SCHEMA_MODE` | no | no | tools/list descriptor mode: slim (default) or full |
| `OMADA_TOOL_CATALOG` | no | no | Tool catalog surface: full (default) or core (omits hotspot voucher tools) |
| `OMADA_TOOL_CATEGORIES` | no | no | Optional comma-separated category filter: core,diagnostics,switch,wifi,routing,security,hotspot,rollback |
| `OMADA_SNAPSHOT_DIR` | no | no | Directory for pre-write snapshots and JSONL write audit logs |
